titles.title: Let Me Enjoy the Extra Life
一人で生きたいお姫様 ※ヒーロー拒絶中

description:
Rosehip has lived through the story of the same novel many times in multiple roles, starting from the female lead to the villainess to even a farmer. Now, she’s a duke’s daughter who is hardly mentioned in the original novel. Determined to spend this extra life in lazy comfort, Rosehip stays out of the main story’s plotline. That is, until the male lead, Ashton, comes knocking on her door. Between her father’s scheming to kick her out and Ashton’s need for a politically convenient fiancee, Rosehip is forced to take a leading role to recover her life outside the spotlight.
